title: Collaboration partners
intro: Organisations that {inst} published with, matched on organisation identifiers. Open a partner for the funders, projects and works you share.

years.default: Works published from {from} to {to}. Partners start in {from}. The year control at the top of the page sets another range.
years.selected: Works published from {from} to {to}, as set in the year control at the top of the page.

map.title: Where the partners are
map.description: Map of the partner organisations. Each circle is one partner in the colour of its organisation type, and a larger circle marks more shared works. A numbered circle groups the partners of one area. The table below lists the same partners.
map.point: {works, plural, one {# shared work} other {# shared works}}
map.group: {count, plural, one {# partner} other {# partners}} in this area
map.groupHint: Select to zoom in, or to list partners that share one place.
map.listTitle: {count, plural, one {# partner} other {# partners}} at this place
map.inView: {count, plural, =0 {No partners in view} one {# partner in view} other {# partners in view}}
map.legend: Partners in view per organisation type
map.caption: Each circle is one partner, coloured by organisation type; larger circles mark more shared works. A numbered circle counts the partners of an area: select it to zoom in, or to list the partners that share one place. Select a partner to open it.
map.unmapped: {count, plural, one {# partner has no coordinates and is not on the map.} other {# partners have no coordinates and are not on the map.}}
map.failed: The map did not load. The table below lists every partner.

summary.line: {partners, plural, one {One partner appears} other {# partners appear}} on {withPartner, plural, one {one} other {#}} of the {works} works that {inst} published from {from} to {to}.
summary.bySource: OpenAlex supplied the partner links for {openalex, plural, one {one work} other {# works}} and OpenAIRE for {openaire, plural, one {one work} other {# works}}.

methodology: How partners are matched and counted

detail.notFound: This organisation is not a collaboration partner in the selected years.
detail.stats: {works, plural, one {# work names} other {# works name}} both organisations, published from {from} to {to}. On {corresponding} of them a corresponding author is affiliated with the partner. The partner's authors hold {authorships} positions on these works.
detail.share: {share}% of the works that {inst} published in these years name this partner.
